purpose: Comprehensive, lawful, rights-verified multi-layer China Dark Data source catalog designed to give Palimpsest broader verifiable signal coverage than or comparable to specialist China intelligence platforms without relying on paywalled redistribution or CFETS-quarantined feeds.

rights_boundary.note: CFETS/ChinaMoney benchmarks remain strictly segregated under config/china_econ_source_policy.json. Every source registered here is independently verified public-domain, CC0, CC-BY-4.0, or official free-redistribution with attribution.
